run_doctest_pickle1: run the doctest suite that verifies Boost.Python pickle support for extension types
test_pickle_world_greet: test pickling and unpickling a Boost.Python world object and verify greet returns the correct string
test_world_reduce: test the __reduce__ method on a Boost.Python world instance to verify it returns the correct class and args tuple
test_noop_pickle_error: test that pickling a Boost.Python noop instance raises a RuntimeError with the expected message
review_pickle_safe_for_unpickling: review the __safe_for_unpickling__ attribute on the Boost.Python world class to verify it equals 1
